excluded: No game assets or executable bytes are hosted. The archive alternate executable was extracted separately for static analysis and bounded emulation only; serial material was not inspected. Its provenance is explicitly modified, not verified pristine retail.

extraction.scope: Extracted installer groups; not a registered Windows installation.

binaryProbe.provenance: Modified alternate runblack.exe bundled in supplied ISO; no claim of pristine retail identity. Never launched as a Windows process. Selected routines executed in Unicorn with synthetic memory and 800x600 screen dimensions.
binaryProbe.limits: Tests start after sampling/keypoint extraction; they do not test live input, full-game dispatch, human recognition accuracy, or exact unmodified retail behavior.

reconstructionSources.upstreamStatus: configure.py marks GestureSystem, Data, DataList and Samples matching for BW1W100; Match and Result remain NonMatching. These are upstream declarations, not a local byte-match build.
